messages:
emma (People Ops): Heads-up team: sara handed in resignation today, last day 2026-05-07. Main items we need: COBRA eligibility & deadlines, benefits cutoff, company phone return, license transfers (JetBrains/Notion), badge/VPN deactivation, final expense reimbursements, and alumni Slack invite. I'll split tasks.

raj (IT): Noted. I can schedule badge deactivation and VPN key revoke for 2026-05-07 17:00 PT. For phone pickup we can do 05/08 courier. Do we want MDM wipe or factory reset done onsite?

sara (Sales): Pickup works for me. Prefer MDM wipe by IT after pickup (no personal data on device). Also I have a company iPad (RW-4477) used for demos.

toni (Benefits): COBRA FYI: plan ends on the last day of the month of termination unless theres a severance extension. So coverage through 05/31. COBRA election packet must go out within 14 business days of termination letter per our admin partner; employee then has 60 days to elect continuation. I'll queue the packet for 05/08.

emma (People Ops): Thanks toni. sara: can you confirm whether you want COBRA packet via mail or email? We can send both if preferred.

sara (Sales): Email is fine, please cc my personal email (sara.personal@example.com).

leo (Eng Manager): Quick note about licenses: sara has a JetBrains All Products license and a Notion seat. We should free the seats for reallocation. Sara, do you keep any personal projects in those work accounts?

sara (Sales): JetBrains only used for side Python scripts (personal) but I pushed none to company repos. Notion has personal pages mixed in. Can we export Notion workspace before removal?

emma (People Ops): Good catch. raj, please coordinate with sara for Notion export. We should remove company billing but allow export window before license termination.

raj (IT): I'll create IT ticket IT-24102. Plan: disable company SSO access 05/07 17:00 PT, keep accounts accessible for export until 05/10 23:59 PT, then deprovision. MDM wipe after device pickup 05/08. I'll send calendar invite with pickup window.

toni (Benefits): Also flag re: post-termination health elections: premium must be paid by the COBRA carrier from election effective date. We'll include contact and payment setup instructions in the packet.

emma (People Ops): Expense note: sara submitted travel for last client trip (04/22) but report missing receipts for parking and dinner (~$75). sara, can you upload receipts to Concur by 05/04 so we can process final reimbursement on 05/15 payroll?

sara (Sales): Will upload today. Thanks for the reminder.

leo (Eng Manager): Requesting exception: can sara keep access to our closed-source sales playbooks folder for 30 days to hand off deals? If it's allowed, we can set a temporary read-only link.

emma (People Ops): We can issue a limited-time access token via shared drive permission with audit logs. But legal needs to sign off on data retention for customer material. @legal slack? (not in thread)

hr-bot: Offboard ticket created: OFF-1790012345. Badge deactivation scheduled 2026-05-07 17:00 PT. COBRA packet scheduled 2026-05-08. Expense reminder sent.

raj (IT): Sara, please confirm serials for phone and iPad so courier can tag items. Also confirm if you have any YubiKey or hardware tokens to return.

sara (Sales): Phone: iPhone 12 - serial G0ZK12345ABC - asset RW-4469. iPad: iPad Pro - serial DMPQ12345XYZ - asset RW-4477. I have one YubiKey (YK-203) which I'll include.

toni (Benefits): Quick policy Q: does Sara have access to commuter benefits? If so we need to close transit card account.

emma (People Ops): She does have commuter deductions. I'll mark transit card for closure 05/10 and pro-rate remaining pre-tax balance to final payroll.

leo (Eng Manager): One last ask: can we send an alumni Slack invite and include sara in the alumni newsletter list? Shes been with us 3 years and might want to stay looped in.

sara (Sales): Yes please, I'd appreciate that.

emma (People Ops): Will add to alumni list. Final action recap:
- IT (raj): schedule pickup 05/08, MDM wipe post-pickup, SSO revoke 05/07 EOD, ticket IT-24102
- Benefits (toni): send COBRA packet 05/08, include payment onboarding instructions
- People Ops (emma): close commuter account 05/10, process PTO/expense reimbursements, add to alumni list
- Manager (leo): temporary read-only drive access request pending legal sign-off

hr-bot: Reminder set for People Ops to run final payroll comp and reimbursements on 2026-05-15 payroll cycle.

raj (IT): I've scheduled pickup window 05/08 09:00-11:00 PT and updated IT-24102. sara I will DM the courier tracking link.

sara (Sales): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the smooth coordination. :heart:
